name: Teotihuacan
events: Spearthrower Owl ascends to the throne and becomes ruler of Teotihuacan (Mexico).
Siyaj K'ak' begins to replace Mayan kings with relatives of Spearthrower Owl, emperor of Teotihuacan.
The Maya are peaking in economic prosperity.
600-750 - Maguey Bloodletting Ritual, fragment of a fresco from Teotihuacan, Mexico, is made.
